gripOrHq.title: Trojan Horse
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if Runner stole any agendas during his or her last turn. Give Runner a tag.

heapOrArchives.title: Rockerboy Promotion
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [15] from the bank on Rockerboy Promotion when you rez it. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rockerboy Promotion. A: Take [3] from Rockerboy Promotion.

heapOrArchives.title: Chance Observation
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

heapOrArchives.rulesText:

Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].

discardCards.title: Short-Term Contract
discardCards.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

discardCards.title: Inside Job
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

discardCards.title: Top Runners' Conference
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

discardCards.title: R&D Interface
discardCards.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

discardCards.title: Bodyweight™ Data Crèche
discardCards.rulesText: Provides +1 MU. Once per turn, right after making a successful run, you can choose to make another run without taking an action to do so. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

discardCards.title: Crash Everett, Inventive Fixer
discardCards.rulesText: Whenever you draw one or more cards from your stack, draw an extra card; then choose one of the cards drawn and either trash it or return it to the top of your stack. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

discardCards.title: All-Nighter
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

discardCards.title: Top Runners' Conference
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

discardCards.title: Rigged Investments
discardCards.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Rigged Investments when it is installed. At the start of each of your turns, take [1] from Rigged Investments. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rigged Investments.

discardCards.title: Forged Activation Orders
discardCards.rulesText: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

rig.title: Deep Thought
rig.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Thought counter. Three or more Thought counters allow you to look at the top card of R&D at the start of each of your turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rig.title: Zetatech Software Installer
rig.rulesText: Put [2] bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overwriting Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

rig.title: Silicon Saloon Franchise
rig.rulesText: A: Gain [1] and draw one card.

rig.title: The Short Circuit
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.
